# Daniel Moshe

> Daniel Moshe is a Minneapolis-based portfolio entrepreneur, national speaker, and Expert EOS Implementer™. He has founded and led five companies and delivered more than 500 EOS sessions, helping leadership teams clarify their vision, build accountability, and gain Traction®.

## About

- **Name:** Daniel Moshe (also "Dan Moshe")
- **Location:** Wayzata / Minneapolis, Minnesota, United States
- **Roles:** Portfolio entrepreneur; Expert EOS Implementer™ (EOS Worldwide); national speaker; leadership team coach; Entrepreneurs' Organization (EO) Accelerator mentor; private pilot; motorsports enthusiast
- **Education:** University of Minnesota, Carlson School of Management
- **Known for:** Being "the caring entrepreneur"; running every business on EOS; 500+ EOS sessions delivered

## What he offers

- **EOS implementation** — helping leadership teams run on the Entrepreneurial Operating System (vision, traction, healthy teams). Offers a free, no-obligation 90-Minute Meeting.
- **Speaking** — keynotes and workshops on EOS, the entrepreneurial journey, technology and operations for professional-services firms, and values-led leadership. CPE instructor with the Minnesota Society of CPAs; has presented at Woodard's Scaling New Heights.
- **Mentoring** — early-stage founders, including through the EO Accelerator program.

## Companies founded & led

- **Tech Guru** (2004, CEO) — nationwide IT services for accounting/CPA firms. https://www.techguruit.com
- **Lucid Day** (2020, Founder & Chairman) — monday.com consulting and workflow implementation. https://www.lucidday.com
- **EOS Implementation Practice** (since 2016) via EOS Worldwide. https://implementer.eosworldwide.com/daniel-moshe/
- **Moshe Motorsports** — family go-kart racing team (Daniel and sons Isaac and Jonah); home track Stockholm Karting Center, Cokato, MN.
- **Sherwood Treehouse** — six-bedroom retreat rental near Minneapolis. https://www.sherwoodtreehouse.com

## Recognition

- Inc. 5000 — America's Fastest-Growing Companies (Tech Guru, 2017 & 2018)
- Fast 50 — Minneapolis/St. Paul Business Journal (Tech Guru)
- Expert EOS Implementer™ with 500+ sessions delivered
